subject.title: Subagent process death emits no telemetry — sessions_spawn failures leave no span/trace

question: What stable diagnostics contract should OpenClaw expose for spawned subagent death or termination events?
rationale: The missing emission path is source-reproducible, but event schema, privacy/cardinality rules, and span relationship are public observability contract choices that automation should not pick alone.

options.title: Add subagent terminal event
options.body: Emit a trusted diagnostic event from the canonical subagent terminal path and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason/outcome fields.

options.title: Annotate sessions_spawn only
options.body: Attach terminal details to the parent sessions_spawn tool span, accepting weaker coverage for child deaths that occur after spawn acceptance.

options.title: Fold into broader dispatch telemetry
options.body: Defer this to the broader dispatch landing telemetry design in #76247, keeping this specific death marker unavailable until that work lands.

recommendation.title: Add subagent terminal event
recommendation.body: Emit a trusted diagnostic event from the canonical subagent terminal path and map it to OTel with redacted identifiers and stable reason/outcome fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest combined history signal covers both the subagent lifecycle paths and the original diagnostics/OTel event surface.
